name: Bill Murray
rootCause: Actor and comedian Bill Murray's personal wallet was stolen, resulting in the loss of funds raised by the actor's charity NFT, hackers stole about 112.05 wETH (worth about $174,000), which was then converted into ETH and sent to 5 EOA, Eventually it was transferred to Binance. The transfer of stolen assets did not indicate any malicious behavior, indicating that a mnemonic phrase was most likely compromised.

descriptions.text: Actor and comedian Bill Murray's personal wallet was stolen, resulting in the loss of funds raised by the actor's charity NFT, hackers stole about 112.05 wETH (worth about $174,000), which was then converted into ETH and sent to 5 EOA, Eventually it was transferred to Binance. The transfer of stolen assets did not indicate any malicious behavior, indicating that a mnemonic phrase was most likely compromised.

Bill Murray auctioned off an NFT representing the right to drink a beer with him, during which a painter will paint a picture of the scene that the buyer can keep. The auction benefits Chive Charities, which is a veteran- and first responder-focused non-profit. The NFT sold for 119.2 ETH (~$185,000). However, hours after the auction, a hacker gained access to Murray's crypto wallet and snagged the ETH for themselves. They also attempted to steal 800 NFTs from the remaining collection by Bill Murray, though a wallet security team was able to safeguard those NFTs in time. Murray's team confirmed the theft, and said they are working with the police and Chainalysis to identify the hacker.
